MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits the practical connection needs behind my DVI cable purchase, although I would need a specific HDMI connection to make before choosing it.",
    "The WiFi extender relates to my networking purchases, but it would only be useful if I were having wireless coverage problems."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices and Alexa products do not solve a current problem suggested by my computer accessory purchases.",
    "The Fire TV Ethernet adapter shares a connection type I use, but it requires a device I have not indicated owning.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not mean I need a replacement tablet; I may simply be supporting equipment I already have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in specific electronic accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in smart devices generally.",
    "Shared words such as Ethernet or tablet seem to matter more than whether the item works with my equipment and serves the same purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases suggest specific tasks involving ports, cables, mounting, and network connections, so compatibility and practical purpose matter to me.",
    "My interactions are infrequent and spread over years; a past accessory purchase does not establish an ongoing need for related equipment.",
    "Even a relevant cable or networking accessory would not prompt me to act unless it solved a concrete need now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in connectivity accessories but extend it too broadly into streaming and smart-home devices without evidence of a current need."
}
